question: What are the key risks for Diginex?

beat.line: Strategy leans on acquisitions, so execution is the key risk.
beat.headline: EXECUTION RISK
beat.action: The previous chip is covered as the two columns fold into interlocking paper blocks; tape pieces press across the seam and hold it shut.

sources: With a strategy reliant on acquisitions and partnerships, the key risk is execution, particularly following the large Resulticks acquisition.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: interlocking paper blocks; tape pieces.
Opens on the two columns, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip is covered as the two columns fold into interlocking paper blocks; tape pieces press across the seam and hold it shut.
Ends holding on the taped seam.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "EXECUTION RISK".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "EXECUTION RISK". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.
expandedPrompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage, cinematic live-action style, photographed flat under soft room light with a consistent light source from the upper left. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, where a lime green paper ground is visible. A cream-colored paper chip in the upper third bears the black, extra-bold sans-serif text "ONE-OFF vs SAAS". Below, two black halftone photographic paper columns with rough white torn edges stand side-by-side, with a halftone hand cutout interacting with them. Immediately, the elements from <Picture 1> slide off-screen to the left and right with fast motion. Simultaneously, a new pale cyan flat block-color paper ground fills the entire frame. A new cream-colored paper chip slides in quickly from the top with a slight overshoot, landing stably in the upper third; it features the clean, legible, black extra-bold sans-serif text "EXECUTION RISK". In the lower two-thirds of the frame, two black halftone photographic paper columns enter from the sides and fold inward with a precise, refined 2D motion, transforming into interlocking paper blocks. Small, rectangular pieces of matte cream paper tape slide across the seams of these blocks, pressing down to hold them shut. Every paper element, including the halftone cutouts and ribbons, possesses a visible matte printed paper texture and casts a small, soft shadow toward the bottom right. The camera remains in a Static Shot for the duration, holding a clear reading window of the taped interlocking blocks and the headline until the end of the 5-second duration.

overall_soundscape: The audio consists of crisp, tactile foley sounds. A light, rhythmic paper-slap occurs as the columns fold and interlock, followed by the distinct, sticky sound of adhesive tape being pressed firmly onto a paper surface.
